Method of Attack: Information stealing malware targeting Intel-based macOS computers
Steals passwords, files, and app data including keychain, Telegram, and Meta (Facebook) services
Exfiltrates data via TCP over port 3000
Delivered via social engineering phishing emails with password-protected zip files containing DMG disk images
Malicious executables disguised as PDF files inside mounted disk images
Attack Vector: Disk image files (DMGs) attached to emails containing malicious executables
Indicators of Compromise: Disk image file names such as 'Advertising terms of reference (MacOS presentation).dmg', 'CONCEPT A3 full menu with dishes and translations to English.dmg', 'AnimatedPoster.dmg', 'Brief_Presentation-Task_Overview-(SOW)-PlayersClub.dmg', 'AdobeOfficialBriefDescription.dmg', 'Adobe Photoshop 2023 (with AI) installer.dmg'
Use of TCP port 3000 for data exfiltration
Malicious Mach-O executables inside application bundles
Unsigned samples despite some having Apple Developer ID
